title: Luistro: Prosecution ready to turn over evidence to Ombudsman

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — House lead prosecutor, Batangas Rep. Gerville “Jinky” Luistro, said Tuesday that the prosecution was ready to turn over evidence from Vice President Sara Duterte’s impeachment trial to the Ombudsman, but favored waiting for the agency’s subpoena before submitting. Luistro said the panel would promptly respond to a formal request for records on the three withdrawn articles of impeachment against the Vice President, namely, confidential funds, bribery, and grave threats.
